body: Floating a matte silver wireless computer mouse on pure white. Clear air gap of one mouse height between the mouse and its gentle drop shadow on the floor. Faint floor reflection, light emphasizing brushed metal top and black scroll wheel. Square 1:1 crop, balanced breathing room on every side, clean commercial packshot. One complete mouse, no support, no text.
